note: The in-game drink menu: common craft-beer styles, written for this game (zh + en). `n` is the slot the drink quiz (src/mood.js) scores; `wallBoard` is the number painted on the boards over the bar (null = not on the wall, 7 = the blackboard). wallBoards are the six painted boards, 3 is on the wall only.

items.name: 捷克皮尔森
items.pitch: 第一杯不知道喝什么？皮尔森准没错。
items.pitch_en: Don't know where to start? A crisp pilsner never lets you down.
items.story: 浅色麦芽配上辛香的萨兹酒花，低温长时间熟成：金黄透亮，中段是柔和的面包香，收口干净利落，带一点苦。
items.story_en: Pale malt and spicy Saaz hops, lagered cold and long: bright gold, a soft bready middle and a clean, snappy bitter finish.

items.name: 浑浊 IPA
items.pitch: 全场人气王：多汁柔顺，一不小心就续杯。
items.pitch_en: The crowd favourite: juicy, soft and dangerously easy to order again.
items.story: 双倍干投 Citra 和 Mosaic 酒花，燕麦和小麦打底。芒果、百香果、橙汁的香气扑面而来，酒体绵软，苦度温和。
items.story_en: Double dry-hopped with Citra and Mosaic over a soft oat-and-wheat base. Mango, passion fruit and orange juice on the nose, a pillowy body and only a gentle bitterness.

items.name: 帝国世涛
items.pitch: 今晚的句号：一杯厚重、要慢慢喝的世涛。
items.pitch_en: Tonight's full stop: a big, slow, roasty nightcap.
items.story: 黑得像午夜的湖水：烘烤大麦、黑巧克力和浓缩咖啡，9% 的暖意适合小口慢慢品。
items.story_en: Black as the lake at midnight: roasted barley, dark chocolate and espresso, a warming 9% that wants to be sipped, not gulped.

items.name: 赫勒斯拉格
items.pitch: 干净顺滑的慕尼黑拉格，适合大口吨吨吨。
items.pitch_en: A clean, smooth Munich-style lager, built for big gulps.
items.story: 柔和的皮尔森麦芽、一点贵族酒花，再加几周低温熟成：淡淡的面包和蜂蜜香，气泡细腻，收口清爽。
items.story_en: Soft pilsner malt, a whisper of noble hops and weeks of cold conditioning: light bread and honey, gentle bubbles and a crisp, dry finish.

items.name: 西海岸 IPA
items.pitch_en: Want a classic IPA? This is the one.
items.story: 干爽明亮：Simcoe、Centennial、Chinook 带来松脂和西柚香，苦度扎实利落。很多人的 IPA 第一杯。
items.story_en: Bone-dry and bright: Simcoe, Centennial and Chinook bring pine resin, grapefruit and a firm, bitter snap. The IPA that started it all.

items.name: 德式小麦
items.pitch: 下了班想犒劳自己，一口就知道今晚属于你。
items.pitch_en: Finished work? One sip and the evening is yours.
items.story: 巴伐利亚小麦啤：一半小麦麦芽，酵母带出香蕉和丁香的香气。浑浊绵密，高杯配上厚厚的白色泡沫。
items.story_en: A Bavarian wheat beer: half wheat malt and a lively yeast that throws banana and clove. Cloudy, fluffy, a tall glass with a big white head.

items.name: 啤酒花气泡水
items.pitch: 一滴酒都不想碰的夜晚，也有好喝的。
items.pitch_en: For the nights you don't want a drop of alcohol, there's still something good.
items.story: 用 Citra 酒花干投的气泡水：有 IPA 的柑橘和松香，没有酒精、没有糖、没有热量。
items.story_en: Sparkling water dry-hopped with Citra: all the citrus and pine of an IPA, with no alcohol, no sugar and no calories.
